Exact TDNN weights from ranks (Demirkaya two-scale DNN, k = 1)

dnn_weights_tdnn_exact_full_from_ranks.Rd

Given a rank permutation ranks, computes the TDNN weight for each observation using the exact rank-weight table from tdnn_rank_table_exact().

Usage

dnn_weights_tdnn_exact_full_from_ranks(ranks, s1, s2, dim)

Arguments

ranks

Integer permutation of 1:n; ranks[i] is the rank (1 = nearest) of observation i relative to the target.

s1

Positive integer; smaller U-statistic order.

s2

Positive integer; larger U-statistic order.

dim

Positive integer; localization dimension.

Value

A list with

  • w: numeric length-n weights in data order (sum to 1, some entries may be negative).

  • w_rank: numeric length-n weights in rank order (1..n).

  • meta: list with n, s1, s2, dim, and scalars (the bias-correction coefficients \(w_1^*, w_2^*\)).

See also

tdnn_rank_table_exact(), rank_weight_tdnn_exact(), dnn_weights_tdnn_asymp_full_from_ranks()

Examples

set.seed(1)
n <- 15L; ranks <- sample.int(n)
out <- dnn_weights_tdnn_exact_full_from_ranks(ranks, s1 = 3L, s2 = 6L, dim = 2L)
sum(out$w)        # 1
#> [1] 1
any(out$w < 0)    # TRUE
#> [1] TRUE
